summary: Phase A (Parts 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4) verified via code inspection + backend live+unit API tests. Backend regression suite (4 tests) and the updated iter165 non-blocking endpoint test all pass. A new live API sanity file was added (test_iter398_phaseA_stuck_users_fix.py, 4 tests, all pass) covering /onboarding/nudge/post-scan-state shape, /cto/projects/{id}/graph status passthrough, /cto/projects/add auth-gating, and /github/oauth/status reachability. Frontend components (GraphReadyCard, IdleStartHelper, updated NewUserWizard, useGitHubConnectStatus) inspected line-by-line and confirmed: all required data-testids exist, aurem:starter-autosend event is dispatched by all 3 GraphReadyCard buttons + IdleStartHelper Yes button, and ChatPanel.jsx has the listener calling send(null,{promptOverride}) directly. Pre-consent paragraphs before both wizard-connect-github and wizard-app-install-btn contain the required 'only chosen repo / never changes without OK / remove or revoke access anytime' statements. MAX_WAIT_MS=3*60_000 confirmed in useGitHubConnectStatus.js. NewUserWizard.connectGithub has both popup_closed and 3-min-timeout branches setting oauthStuck plus a visibilitychange 10-min backstop; wizard-no-github-fallback-btn is only rendered when appDenied (not appTimedOut), per spec. build_graph_guarded wraps build_graph with a 240s wait_for + exactly one retry + writes status='error' doc on double-failure. GET /cto/projects/{id}/graph returns doc.get('status') or 'ready' (no longer hardcoded). aurem:open-starter-choices dispatches are wired to StarterChoiceModal (always mounted on Dashboard). Live frontend login worked (test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026!) but that account already has projects so the wizard/GraphReadyCard/IdleStartHelper don't render for it — full live E2E for those components would require a fresh signup + real GitHub App install popup + real repo, which is outside the scope of this preview session (and the founder request explicitly says code-level verification is acceptable here). Zero new regressions detected.
action_items: OPTIONAL: add a new vitest test for NewUserWizard.connectGithub() using window.open mock + fake timers, covering (a) popup_closed => oauthStuck, (b) 3-min timeout => oauthStuck, (c) visibilitychange after 10min => oauthStuck. The current code has no direct unit test for this specific new path — the user's request itself flags this as a gap ('genuinely NEW code path, no pre-existing tests, needs real coverage').

OPTIONAL: add a component-level vitest for GraphReadyCard + IdleStartHelper verifying the aurem:starter-autosend event payload and (for IdleStartHelper) the sessionStorage cap + 3-min timer + endpoint call — code review verified the logic but there is no automated regression guard.

OPTIONAL live E2E follow-up (not doable in this preview session): a real fresh signup + real GitHub App install against a real test org would confirm GraphReadyCard renders with real file_count and IdleStartHelper fires end-to-end. Founder explicitly said code-level verification is acceptable here so this is not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: GraphReadyCard's `dismissed` state is set inside `pick()` right before `setDismissed(true)` is redundant with the effect resetting on projectId/visible change — that's fine, no bug.

IdleStartHelper's dismiss X (`idle-start-helper-not-now`) sets `setShow(false)` but does NOT also set the sessionStorage key — however, sessionStorage IS set at the moment the banner is FIRST shown (line 50), so dismissing and re-showing in the same session is prevented, as required. Verified correct.
NewUserWizard.connectGithub: the popup null-return branch (line 387-390) returns early but does NOT clear oauthStartedRef — trivial, has no effect because pollRef.current is not started. Non-issue.
visibilitychange listener at line 432 correctly gates on ghStatus !== 'connected' && !oauthStuck to avoid firing twice; safe.
useGitHubConnectStatus already had its own passing unit test suite (per review request); did not re-run vitest here.

success_rate.frontend: code-verified (100% of testids/copy/event-wiring items in review request confirmed present); live E2E for GraphReadyCard/IdleStartHelper/oauthStuck NOT executed due to needing fresh signup + real GitHub App install (see action_items)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A is complete and code-verified end-to-end. For Phases B-F (parts 3-6, not yet built), start from a fresh review request. If a follow-up wants a REAL live E2E of GraphReadyCard: create a NEW signup account, complete GitHub App install against a small test org/repo, connect a project via /cto/projects/add, wait ~15-60s for build_graph_guarded to complete, then open the chat panel with 0 messages — GraphReadyCard should auto-appear polling /cto/projects/{id}/graph. Same for IdleStartHelper: after that, don't type anything for 3 minutes (or override IDLE_MS in the source for testing) — banner should appear, clicking Yes should send a real chat message via aurem:starter-autosend. Session cap: sessionStorage key 'aurem_idle_start_helper_shown'.
rca of the issue: N/A — this is a feature verification pass, not a bug-repro pass. All fixes described in the review request map to correct code and pass their own tests.
